mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies with temperatures at 55 degrees, feeling like 52, down by Harriet Park. It is currently a waxing crescent moon phase.
Looking at city news, there were no new urgent emails or flash alerts to report to the community this morning.

There is a lot happening in Verona today. You can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, grab a slice at the Wisconsin Brewing Company for Pizza and a Pitcher, or test your brain at Trivia Night held at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on October 7 at 7:50 AM, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a 17-year-old on an electric motorcycle near Basswood Avenue and Hemlock Drive.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence, which is sure to be a hit. The Culver's of Verona will open its doors today at 10:00 AM.
